# hookbase_webhook_application (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase webhook application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Outbound webhook application for a customer
resource "hookbase_webhook_application" "acme" {
  name        = "Acme Corp"
  external_id = "cust_acme_123"

  rate_limit_per_second = 50
  rate_limit_per_minute = 500
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application name.

### Optional

- `disabled_reason` (String) Reason the application was disabled.
- `external_id` (String) External identifier for the application. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the application is disabled.
- `metadata` (String) Arbitrary metadata as a JSON string.
- `rate_limit_per_hour` (Number) Rate limit per hour.
- `rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Rate limit per minute.
- `rate_limit_per_second` (Number) Rate limit per second.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
